task.title: Open a saved profile in an editor
task.shortdesc: Open the same saved profile in Guided editor, All settings, or JSON editor depending on the change you need.

prereq.p: The profile is visible in the Library and its row identity matches the profile you intend to edit or inspect.

context.p: Opening a saved profile does not duplicate it. Each editor surface works with the same saved profile identity.

step.cmd: Use the row title or guided action for task-oriented edits.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens the profile in Guided editor.

step.cmd: Use All settings when you need the complete supported catalog and source/attention details.

info.p: This is the safest choice for detailed policy and preference inspection.

step.cmd: Use JSON editor when you need to inspect or edit the raw boundary document.

info.note: Raw JSON changes should be validated before export or comparison.

result.p: The selected editor opens in its own profile context and keeps the same profile ID.

postreq.p: Recovery: if you opened the wrong editor, return to the Library row or use another editor link for the same profile.
